from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEPSRecord(BaseModel):
    """An earnings per share record extracted from a single company's financial report."""
    company_name: str = Field(..., description="The full name of the company as stated in the report")
    reporting_period: str = Field(..., description="The financial reporting period (e.g., '2024 First Quarter')")
    earnings_per_share: float = Field(..., description="The earnings per share value reported")
    currency: str = Field(..., description="The currency unit of the EPS value")
    eps_metric_type: str = Field(..., description="The type of EPS metric reported (e.g., 'Basic', 'Diluted')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    eps_records: list[CompanyEPSRecord]
